item.title: Agentman 0.44.0
item.description:
## Your notes reach every agent
- Tick "Every agent follows this" on a note and every agent gets it in its own instructions, including agents already running. - Muse and Cursor, which read their instructions only at start, get new notes with their next message, and again after they compact. - Muse can now use Agentman's tools, like every other agent.
## Agents
- End any session, from its page, the sidebar or the Board. Its page stays, to read and resume. - Idle agents stay listed for three days. - Muse: `/compact` really compacts, and a compacted chat keeps what came before. - Agentman says before you agree when a command will bring up a macOS permission dialog. - Claude Code 2.1.322's question forms read cleanly. - The Board shows a working agent in Working, and a card goes once you've answered in the agent.
## The Mac app
- A cleaner filter that can show any folder, with New Agent Here for one with no agents yet. - The editor: an agent's changes in a tab of their own, History and Diff tabs, and the Usage popover shows its cards whole. - Terminals follow you between the editor and an agent's page, and slide as they open and close. - A chat that fails to load recovers by itself. - Settings › Devices lists each phone once.

item.title: Agentman 0.43.0
item.description:
## The Board
Agentman's page is now a Board: every agent in **Needs you**, **Working** or **Idle**, with what it's doing on its card. Answer questions, commit and push right from the card, search every agent and everything they've said, and color agents by state, project or folder.
## Also new
- Agentman can check finished work, notice stuck agents, and answer the simple yes-or-no questions you choose. All of it is off until you turn it on in Settings under Permissions. - "Worked for 4m" after each request. - Quote part of a reply in your next message. - Fewer "needs you" cards, and more permission prompts recognised across agents. - Safer auto-approval.

item.title: Agentman 0.42.0
item.description:
## Agentman 0.42.0
- **A new look to try.** Settings › General › Appearance › Theme now offers **New**: the website's look, with Rubik headings, warm edges, cream cards, orange accents and animated stickers on the setup and empty screens. It's still being designed; **Classic**, the look you know, stays the default.

item.title: Agentman 0.41.2
item.description: - Start typing immediately when you open an agent chat or Agentman chat, including chats in the editor panel. - Chat updates respect your focus when you move to search, a terminal, or another control. - Fix Codex notification setup on fresh installs. - Show clearer setup failure details and retry Claude tool configuration when needed.

item.title: Agentman 0.41.0
item.description:
## Agentman 0.41.0
- **Works outside full screen.** The editor's top bar, a conversation's title and the Usage page's buttons all show and respond in a normal window. - **Usage in the editor.** A Usage button in the editor's status bar shows your spending and plan limits, and ⌘K opens right over the editor. - **Antigravity limits.** The Limits tab now shows what's left of your Antigravity plan. - **Agents that need you come first** in the sidebar, and the message box answers an agent's question directly. - **Clearer when something's wrong.** A banner with Restart if Agentman loses its connection, and a terminal you open takes your typing straight away.

item.title: Agentman 0.40.0
item.description:
## Agentman 0.40.0
- **Everything in one app.** Agentman for Mac now carries `am` and sets it up on first launch. No terminal steps needed. - **Updates itself.** The app checks for updates and installs them, and keeps `am serve` on the same version. - **Stays matched.** When `am serve` is newer than the app, the app offers to update, or does it automatically if you ask it to.
